signal: PathAI got FDA clearance for AISight Dx in 2025, signed partnerships with Northwestern Medicine and University Hospital Zurich, and is being acquired by Roche for up to $1.05B

email.body1:
Nick, saw PathAI cleared AISight Dx with the FDA and lined up University Hospital Zurich and Northwestern on top of the Roche news.

Momentum like that opens more health systems and labs than a growth team can personally cover, and that is where pipeline quietly leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for PathAI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: meetings to hit the growth number
email.body2:
Nick, quick follow-up for PathAI.

With AISight Dx cleared and major partnerships live, expectations on commercial pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most growth leaders can't say precisely how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings PathAI needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Nick, last bit of proof for PathAI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how PathAI's reply rate likely compares to similar growth-stage health-tech companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Nick, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling commercial pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. An FDA-clearance and acquisition stretch is its own kind of busy, and timing matters here.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to PathAI's motion? I'll tailor it to your team either way.
